properties.name: Andheri West
properties.methodNote: Approximate locality polygon created for TreeScore canopy-cover analysis. Not an official administrative boundary.
properties.sourceNote: Boundary drawn using visible locality context, major roads, coastline, railway/metro corridors, lake/park edges and commonly understood neighbourhood extent. East edge held west of the Western Railway line to avoid Andheri East; west edge near the Versova coast.

properties.name: Powai
properties.methodNote: Approximate locality polygon created for TreeScore canopy-cover analysis. Not an official administrative boundary. Inner ring excludes the main Powai Lake water body from the land area.
properties.sourceNote: Boundary drawn around the commonly understood Powai urban fabric (Hiranandani area, lake-edge residential, JVLR corridor). Touches the IIT Bombay edge only. Excludes Vikhroli and the Sanjay Gandhi National Park influence zone. Main lake water body cut out as an inner ring; any residual water should also be masked during NDVI analysis.

properties.name: Juhu
properties.methodNote: Approximate locality polygon created for TreeScore canopy-cover analysis. Not an official administrative boundary.
properties.sourceNote: Boundary drawn using the Arabian Sea coastline/beach as the western edge and the commonly understood Juhu residential/coastal neighbourhood. Kept conservative to avoid extending into Vile Parle, Santacruz, Andheri West or Versova.
